description: This file defines the AsyncQueryManager class and related functions for managing asynchronous query jobs, cache backends, and event streams in the Superset project.

classes.name: AsyncQueryManager
classes.description: Manages asynchronous query jobs, event streams, and cache interactions within Superset.

classes.name: CacheBackendNotInitialized
classes.description: Exception raised when cache backend is not initialized.

classes.name: AsyncQueryTokenException
classes.description: Exception for errors related to JWT token parsing or validation.

classes.name: UnsupportedCacheBackendError
classes.description: Exception for unsupported cache backend configurations.

classes.name: AsyncQueryJobException
classes.description: Exception for errors related to async query jobs.

methods.name: build_job_metadata
methods.description: Constructs metadata dictionary for a query job.

methods.name: parse_event
methods.description: Parses event data from stream into a dictionary.

methods.name: increment_id
methods.description: Increments Redis stream ID in string format.

methods.name: get_cache_backend
methods.description: Returns appropriate cache backend instance based on configuration.

methods.name: init_app
methods.description: Initializes AsyncQueryManager with Flask app configuration.

methods.name: register_request_handlers
methods.description: Registers request handlers for session validation and JWT token management.

methods.name: parse_channel_id_from_request
methods.description: Extracts channel ID from request cookies using JWT token.

methods.name: init_job
methods.description: Creates initial job metadata with a new UUID and pending status.

methods.name: submit_explore_json_job
methods.description: Submits a job to process explore JSON data asynchronously.

methods.name: submit_chart_data_job
methods.description: Submits a job to process chart data asynchronously.

methods.name: read_events
methods.description: Reads events from Redis stream for a given channel and last ID.

methods.name: update_job
methods.description: Updates job status and logs event data into Redis streams.
